column1: # Go-parity commands: id <TAB> fixture <TAB> [ENV=value ...] arguments
# Each line, in every file of fixtures/parity/ (one per noun, design §8.4),
# is run by scripts/go-library-goldens.sh against Go ctxloom
# (release/0.7 860336c4e) to make fixtures/golden/<id>.stdout and .exit, and
# by the Rust acceptance test (library_parity.test.rs) against this binary.
# Source of every line: the Go feature named in the id's group comment.
# OD-40 (design §8.1): Go parity ends for JSON. An agent's JSON is its AIP
# resource (ListAgentsResponse, Agent), held by library-cli's and
# library_cli_agent's tests and agent.feature; its JSON rows are retired, the
# text rows (and the rows that hold a refusal) stay as Go parity.
# cli/agent.feature
agent-list-text
agent-show-developer-text
agent-show-unknown
# ctxloom-project bundle, adapters/content's tree fixtures, a premised bundle
# Configuration: schema 8 and older, layering, strict decode (cli/config.feature, fault_tolerance.feature)
cfg-v8-agent-show-json
cfg-layers-agent-list-json
# Nothing there: no content directory at all, and an empty one (empty_listing_hint, cli/agent.feature)
empty-agent-list-text
emptybundles-agent-list-text
# No project here (configload/appdir.go: no .ctxloom up the path, so the home's config alone)
noproject-agent-list-text
